import os, shutil, sqlite3, subprocess, sys, tempfile
import login

work = os.getcwd()
copy_db = os.path.join(work, "smoke_copy.db")
fresh_db = os.path.join(work, "smoke_fresh.db")

shutil.copyfile("user_credentials.db", copy_db)
if os.path.exists(fresh_db):
    os.remove(fresh_db)

fails = []
def check(label, cond):
    print(("PASS" if cond else "FAIL"), "-", label)
    if not cond:
        fails.append(label)

# ---- 1. Registering into a COPY of the existing seeded DB -----------------
conn = login.connect(copy_db)
login.initialize_schema(conn)                      # must be a no-op on existing schema
n_before = conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users").fetchone()[0]
new_id = login.register_user(conn, "smoke.user", "smoke.user@example.com", "SuperSecret1!")
check("register returns id > existing max", new_id == n_before + 1)
row = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM users WHERE username = ?", ("smoke.user",)).fetchone()
check("row persisted with access_rights='user'", row is not None and row["access_rights"] == "user")
check("password_hash is 64-char hex", row["password_hash"] == login._password_digest("SuperSecret1!") and len(row["password_hash"]) == 64)
check("created_date is today ISO", row["created_date"] == __import__("datetime").date.today().isoformat())
check("login with correct password", login.authenticate(conn, "smoke.user", "SuperSecret1!") is True)
check("login with wrong password", login.authenticate(conn, "smoke.user", "wrongpass1") is False)
check("login unknown user", login.authenticate(conn, "ghost.user", "SuperSecret1!") is False)

# duplicate / validation guards
for label, fn in [
    ("duplicate username rejected", lambda: login.register_user(conn, "smoke.user", "other@example.com", "SuperSecret1!")),
    ("duplicate email rejected", lambda: login.register_user(conn, "other.user", "smoke.user@example.com", "SuperSecret1!")),
    ("short password rejected", lambda: login.register_user(conn, "short.user", "short@example.com", "1234567")),
    ("bad email rejected", lambda: login.register_user(conn, "bad.user", "not-an-email", "SuperSecret1!")),
    ("whitespace username rejected", lambda: login.register_user(conn, "bad user", "bad@example.com", "SuperSecret1!")),
]:
    try:
        fn(); check(label, False)
    except ValueError:
        check(label, True)
    except Exception as e:
        check(label + f" (wrong exc {type(e).__name__})", False)

# existing seed row still authenticates under the same scheme (sha256 hex)
check("seed admin hash format is compatible (64-hex)", len(conn.execute("SELECT password_hash FROM users WHERE username='admin'").fetchone()[0]) == 64)
conn.close()

# ---- 2. Fresh database: schema auto-creation -------------------------------
conn = login.connect(fresh_db)
login.initialize_schema(conn)
check("fresh DB users table created", conn.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='users'").fetchone() is not None)
uid = login.register_user(conn, "fresh.user", "fresh@example.com", "FreshPass9!")
check("fresh DB register works", uid == 1 and login.authenticate(conn, "fresh.user", "FreshPass9!"))
conn.close()

# ---- 3. CLI smoke test (piped stdin, non-interactive getpass fallback) -----
env = dict(os.environ)
r = subprocess.run(
    [sys.executable, "login.py", "--db", copy_db, "register",
     "--username", "cli.user", "--email", "cli@example.com"],
    input="CliPass123!\nCliPass123!\n", text=True, capture_output=True, env=env,
)
check("CLI register exit 0", r.returncode == 0 and "Registered 'cli.user'" in r.stdout)
r = subprocess.run(
    [sys.executable, "login.py", "--db", copy_db, "login", "--username", "cli.user"],
    input="CliPass123!\n", text=True, capture_output=True, env=env,
)
check("CLI login exit 0", r.returncode == 0 and "Login successful" in r.stdout)
r = subprocess.run(
    [sys.executable, "login.py", "--db", copy_db, "login", "--username", "cli.user"],
    input="WrongPass1!\n", text=True, capture_output=True, env=env,
)
check("CLI login wrong pw exit 1", r.returncode == 1)

# real DB untouched?
with sqlite3.connect("file:user_credentials.db?mode=ro", uri=True) as real:
    check("real user_credentials.db untouched (12 rows)", real.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users").fetchone()[0] == 12)

# cleanup disposable files
os.remove(copy_db); os.remove(fresh_db)
print("\nRESULT:", "ALL PASS" if not fails else f"FAILURES: {fails}")
sys.exit(1 if fails else 0)
